local.scope: Local isolated fixtures only; no shared data inserted.

limits: Remote checks are catalogue and original-data proof; behavior was exercised locally by pgTAP/RLS only.
No production UI, purchase-order creation, offer update, conversion fixture, PDF or email journey was run on the shared database.
Existing PU check name differs from canonical, with identical predicate; no rename was made.

Five shared-only and two canonical-only older function signatures are recorded in verification.preservedHistoricalCatalogueDifferences. They do not concern M7 or the six prerequisites and were not changed; global canonical equivalence is not claimed.
